tasks.prompt: This data pipeline silently produces wrong aggregations: blank CSV cells in the score column are treated as 0 instead of missing data. tests/test_blank_cells.py reproduces the failure. Fix the pipeline so blank cells are treated as missing. Every test in the suite must pass when you finish. Do not add third-party dependencies. When finished, reply with a single final line: DONE.

Add a top-N feature to this data pipeline. Implement pipeline.aggregate.top_n(values, n): it returns the n largest values in descending order, all values when n exceeds the count, and an empty list when n <= 0. Wire a --top N flag into pipeline.cli: after the existing mean line, print one line per value formatted exactly as top_<i><TAB><value with 4 decimals>, with i starting at 1; print no top lines when N <= 0. All existing tests must stay green. Do not add third-party dependencies. When finished, reply with a single final line: DONE.

Refactor pipeline.transform: extract the clipping logic out of normalize_range into a standalone clip(values, lo, hi) function in the same module. normalize_range must keep exactly its current behavior for every input. All existing tests must stay green. Do not add third-party dependencies. When finished, reply with a single final line: DONE.
